🎓 How to Use the Positioning Strategy Skill

Use this skill in Joule to generate complete messaging frameworks in seconds.

💬

Trigger Phrases

  • "Build messaging for [product]"
  • "Value proposition for CIO"
  • "Messaging framework for..."
  • "How do I position [solution]"
  • "Create talk tracks for..."
📝

Sample Prompt

"Create a messaging framework for SAP S/4HANA Cloud targeting manufacturing companies. Include value props for CIO, CFO, and Plant Manager. Emphasize AI capabilities and sustainability."
📊

What You'll Get

  • Core Value Prop — Foundational positioning statement
  • Persona Messages — Tailored headline, message, proof
  • Competitive Angles — Differentiation points
  • Talk Tracks — Ready-to-use conversation starters
💡

Pro Tips

  • Be specific — Include industry and company size
  • Name competitors — "Differentiate from Oracle"
  • Add constraints — "Keep headlines under 10 words"
  • Request variations — "Give me 3 options for each"
